title: Lattice
description: A finite lattice, presented by its carrier (distinct element labels) and partial order leq (as [a,b] pairs meaning a <= b; reflexive-transitively closed downstream). Meets and joins exist and are verified by the operating morphisms. This is the base object the value algebra (residuated-lattice) and the algebras the nuclei act on (Heyting algebras) extend or reference -- so those objects reference this schema rather than re-declaring carrier/leq out of band.
